description: This Java interface defines metrics related to HTTP adapters in the Eclipse Hono project, including a nested no-op implementation class.

classes.name: HttpAdapterMetrics
classes.description: An interface extending Metrics, providing HTTP adapter metrics functionalities, with a default singleton no-op implementation.

classes.name: HttpAdapterMetrics.Noop
classes.description: A static nested class implementing NoopBasedMetrics and HttpAdapterMetrics, representing a no-operation metrics implementation.

methods.name: HttpAdapterMetrics.NOOP
methods.description: A static final instance of the Noop class serving as the singleton no-op implementation.
